def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_r = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and r not in (0, h-1)), None)
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c not in (0, w-1)), None)
    if sep_r is not None and (sep_c is None or w >= h):
        n = min(sep_r, h-sep_r-1)
        a, b = grid[sep_r-n:sep_r], grid[sep_r+1:sep_r+1+n]
        # separator is a horizontal division
        bg = max(set(x for row in a+b for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in a+b))
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == b[i][j] else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
    if sep_c is not None:
        n = min(sep_c, w-sep_c-1)
        bg = max(set(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in list(range(sep_c-n, sep_c))+list(range(sep_c+1, sep_c+1+n))), key=lambda x: sum(grid[r][c] == x for r in range(h) for c in list(range(sep_c-n, sep_c))+list(range(sep_c+1, sep_c+1+n))))
        return [[3 if grid[r][sep_c-n+j] == grid[r][sep_c+1+j] else bg for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('separator not found')

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and 0 < r < h-1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and 0 < c < w-1]
    sr = min(rows, key=lambda r: abs(r-(h-1)/2)) if rows else None
    sc = min(cols, key=lambda c: abs(c-(w-1)/2)) if cols else None
    use_row = sr is not None and (sc is None or abs(sr-(h-1)/2) <= abs(sc-(w-1)/2))
    if use_row:
        n = min(sr, h-sr-1)
        a, b = grid[sr-n:sr], grid[sr+1:sr+1+n]
        ca, cb = {x for row in a for x in row}, {x for row in b for x in row}
        common = ca & cb
        base = next(iter(common)) if len(common)==1 else max(common, key=lambda x: sum(v==x for row in a+b for v in row))
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == b[i][j] else base for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
    if sc is not None:
        n = min(sc, w-sc-1)
        a = [[grid[r][sc-n+j] for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
        b = [[grid[r][sc+1+j] for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
        ca, cb = {x for row in a for x in row}, {x for row in b for x in row}
        common = ca & cb
        base = next(iter(common)) if len(common)==1 else max(common, key=lambda x: sum(v==x for row in a+b for v in row))
        return [[3 if a[r][j] == b[r][j] else base for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('separator not found')
print('mismatches', [sum(x!=y for rowx,rowy in zip(transform(a),o) for x,y in zip(rowx,rowy)) for a,o in [(D1i,D1o),(D2i,D2o),(D3i,D3o)]])
